{| {{STDT|mech1 no-odd-even {{#if: {{{expandable|}}} | expandable }} }} style="display:table;" {{#ask:[[Has achievement category::{{{category|+}}}]] {{#if: {{{activity|}}} | [[Is part of activity::{{{activity}}}]] }} {{#if: {{{parent|}}} | [[Is part of achievement::{{{parent}}}]] }} {{#if: {{{reward|}}} | [[Gives item::{{{reward}}}]] }} {{#if: {{{mastery|}}} | [[Gives mastery track region point::{{{mastery}}}]] }} {{{other|}}} {{#switch: {{{include historical|y}}} | n = [[Has achievement category.Is historical::N]] | only = [[Has achievement category.Is historical::Y]] }} | ?Has canonical name | ?Has achievement type | ?Has game description | ?Has prerequisite | ?Gives item | ?Gives item quantity | ?Gives title | ?Has achievement tiers | ?Has achievement category | ?Has flavor text | ?Has achievement page | ?Has unlock item | ?Has game icon | ?Gives mastery track region point | ?Has game id# | ?Is hidden achievement | ?Has achievement tier rewards | ?Has achievement collection | ?Has achievement objectives | ?Has achievement page section | ?Gives mastery track region point quantity | ?Has achievement category.Has canonical name | ?Is historical | link = none | format = template | introtemplate = Achievement list header{{!}}heading={{{heading|}}} | template = Achievement box result format{{!}}reward={{{reward|}}}{{!}}expanded={{#if: {{{expanded|}}}|true|false}}{{!}}hide collection={{#if: {{{hide collection|}}}|true|false}} | sort = {{{sort| {{#if: {{{mastery|}}} | Is historical, Has achievement category, Has canonical name | Is historical, Has achievement category.Has achievement group sort order, Has achievement category.Has achievement category sort order, Has page name.Has canonical name }} }}} | limit = 250 | default = {{#if: {{NAMESPACE}}||[[Category:Pages with empty semantic mediawiki query results]]}} }} |} == Description == Generates a list of achievements for the set parameters. If the query returns only one result, then it mirrors the format from {{tl|Achievement box}} (used for single achievements) by suppressing the additional heading. Format using {{tl|Achievement box result format}} and {{tl|Achievement list header}}. == Usage == 
{{Achievement list
| category = 
| activity = 
| reward = 
}}
=== Parameters === ;category :Optional. Constrain to achievements in a certain achievement category. ;activity :Optional. Constrain achievements to a related activity. ;reward :Optional. The item received upon completion of the achievement. ;mastery :Optional. The mastery point reward given, e.g. "Central Tyria" or "Heart of Maguuma" ;heading :Optional. Change the heading for the table from "Achievements" to whatever is specified. ;expandable :Optional. Avoid using this where possible. If set, causes the achievement list to be collapsed into a small element with a button to "show" the list. ;expanded :Optional. If set, fully expands the collapsed tier, objectives and tier rewards subtables. ;hide collection :Optional. If set, hides the collection. ;include historical :Optional. By default, historical achievements are shown in lists generated by this template. Setting this parameter equal to n will remove historical achievements from the results. Setting this parameter equal to only will only show historical achievements. ;sort :Optional. Allows to sort by a list of properties. ;other :Optional. Custom quary. === Examples === 
{{achievement list|reward=Adventurer's Box}}
{{achievement list|reward=Adventurer's Box}} 
{{achievement list|reward=Ascended Weapon Chest}}
{{achievement list|reward=Ascended Weapon Chest}} 
{{achievement list|activity=Sanctum Sprint}}
{{achievement list|activity=Sanctum Sprint}} 
{{achievement list|activity=Sanctum Sprint|include historical=n}}
{{achievement list|activity=Sanctum Sprint|include historical=n}} 
{{achievement list|reward=Bonus Box of Goods|include historical=n}}
;Historical
{{achievement list|reward=Bonus Box of Goods|include historical=only|expandable=y}}
{{achievement list|reward=Bonus Box of Goods|include historical=n}} ;Historical {{achievement list|reward=Bonus Box of Goods|include historical=only|expandable=y}} == See also == * {{tl|achievement box}} — for single achievements [[Category:Achievement formatting templates]] [[es:Plantilla:Lista de logros]]
